newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Compact Metal to lease land site.
newsitem.headline: Compact Metal to lease land site.

text.p: Compact Metal Industries Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to lease a 17,000 sq.metre site for the construction of a corporate headquarters building and factory.
The company said in a statement the site would be leased from Jurong Town Corporation for 30 years, with an option for a further term of 28 years.
It said the minimum building cost was expected to be around Singapore $17.85 million and investment in equipment would be at least S$6.8 million.
Financing will be from internal funds and bank borrowings and construction is expected to be completed before February 15, 1999.

Compact Metal said rental for the premises would be S$21.55 per square metre per year from February 16, 1997 to February 15 1998. After that, it said the rent would be revised based on prevailing market rates but not exceeding 7.6 percent of the annual rent for each immediate preceding year.
